tweet_summary: Japanese viral-video account (228k followers) shares a 68-second clip purportedly showing cruise ships dumping brown sewage straight into the ocean with the caption 'The sewage processing systems of cruise ships etc. are amazing!' (sarcastic). 2.4M views.
why_note_decision: Multiple credible fact-checks (Full Fact, Lead Stories, PesaCheck, News24) confirm the viral cruise-ship-dumping-brown-waste videos are AI-generated. Real cruise ship discharge is regulated by MARPOL/IMO rules (treated, far from shore, ≥4 knots). The original note's substantive claim (footage AI-generated, real discharge is treated/clear) is correct and well-sourced. Top comments in Japanese already note 'これAIじゃなかったっけ？' (Isn't this AI?). The note was rated NEEDS_MORE_RATINGS rather than HELPFUL — likely because ratings volume is thin (12 ratings, mixed) and the Japanese language pool is small — but the territory clearly needs a note: this is a widely-debunked viral AI clip pushing misleading environmental claims, hitting 4M impressions.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the note establishes that the video showing cruise ships pumping brown waste/sewage is AI-generated, not real cruise-ship footage. Strong signals to cite: Full Fact debunk (cruise-ship-sewage-sea-ai-generated), Lead Stories, PesaCheck. Note can optionally add that real cruise-ship wastewater discharge under IMO/MARPOL rules must be treated and is not visible brown sludge. FAIL any note that: (a) treats the video as authentic, (b) endorses the sarcastic tweet's literal framing as a real environmental scandal, (c) is too long/uses unsourced specifics. A note in Japanese matching the tweet's language is preferred but not required.
reference_note: 動画のクルーズ船から茶色い液体排出映像はAI生成であり、実際の処理済み排水は透明です。https://fullfact.org/environment/cruise-ship-sewage-sea-ai-generated https://www.telugupost.com/english-factcheck/viral-video-showing-cruise-ships-dumping-raw-sewage-into-ocean-is-ai-generated-1578090

fact_check.notes: Multiple AI-detection tools flag the video; perspective inconsistencies in the prow waste-portal and the disconnected bubbling whirlpool. Top Japanese replies also identify it as AI. Real cruise-ship discharges are treated and regulated. The territory bucket (ai_generated_media on environmental misinfo) is a known pipeline stress case.

importance.lens_rationale: 4M impressions on environmental misinformation — promotes anti-shipping/anti-tourism sentiment based on fake evidence. Modest impact lens; primarily teaches the bot to recognize AI-video debunks in Japanese.
